Vendored under issue #137: apps/site/page/support.js (the owner-supplied
dc-runtime) loaded these three from unpkg.com at read time; every visit told
unpkg the visitor's IP. Same pinned versions and bytes unpkg served --
verified by sha384 against the SRI hashes already in support.js before
vendoring, not assumed -- so support.js's own integrity check still holds.
